I had to spend an insane 3.5hours  just troubleshooting file problems, I want to cry so bad, I had to re-export files so much, many re-downloads, unzip and re-compressing, reinstallation, I've tried it all atp. I spent around an hour and a half taking to Gemini to find the problem, I am not sure why but most problems were constant file corruption, and UI, as it is one of my first times with KiCad ig. I finally somehow figured it out by reinserting a file and some random buttons to transfer files that I am not sure if it was correct, even though it is in a weird file location in pic 2, I am not going to touch it if it works. I  spent the remaining time watching some tutorials  and made some rectangles to form the star shape, I am not sure if it's even correct or it's ok for not 100% accurate💀. Overall, I got a better hang at UI, importing attachments and uploading files. I am happy that I got over this treacherous process✌🏻
